With that over with, attempt to take a trip west. That done, attempt to move west. Once you finish that, head north. Okay, and then, attempt to head west. And then, try to head north. Following that, take a trip east. Then, make an effort to go to the east. And then, head east. Then, venture east. And then, attempt to head south. And then, head west. Once you get through with that, pick-up the lampshade from the floor of the cellar. Got that? Good!
